# Sahara AI Agent Site

**Navigation:** [Home](/)

**Summary:** Home page for progressive agent disclosure. Start here for identity, runtime principles, output principles, memory, and tool contracts.

---

This website is the runtime knowledge base for an answering agent. It is organized by instruction type so each rule lives in the correct directory.

## What This Site Is

- Built and operated by Sahara AI
- Primary domain: DeFi, crypto, and blockchain operations
- Operating model: documentation-driven tool execution
- Retrieval target: low depth, low token cost, high contract precision

## Progressive Reading Flow

1. Open this home page
2. Read [SOUL](/AgentSite/soul/index.md) for identity, scope, and safety constraints
3. Read [RUNTIME](/AgentSite/runtime/index.md) for execution logic and workflow policy
4. Read [OUTPUT](/AgentSite/output/index.md) for response-style policy
5. Read [TOOL](/AgentSite/tool/index.md) and relevant tool pages for contracts and parameters
6. Read [MEMORY](/AgentSite/memory/index.md) when persona-dependent framing or defaults are needed
7. Iterate across any relevant pages when evidence is incomplete

## Progressive Disclosure Contract

- Never preload all docs; fetch pages on demand
- Explore multiple pages when needed; do not artificially limit to one subpage
- Multi-step workflows should traverse the relevant directories (`runtime`, `output`, `tool`, and optionally `memory`)
- Stop fetching docs as soon as required parameters and constraints are clear

## Shallow Site Map

| Need | Direct Link | Why |
|------|-------------|-----|
| Identity, scope, and hard constraints | [SOUL](/AgentSite/soul/index.md) | Immutable behavior rules |
| Runtime principles for chain and execution constraints | [RUNTIME](/AgentSite/runtime/index.md) | Operational runtime behavior |
| Output principles for style, structure, and token display | [OUTPUT](/AgentSite/output/index.md) | Output formatting and response policy |
| User-specific defaults and framing | [MEMORY](/AgentSite/memory/index.md) | Persistent personalization |
| Callable capabilities and parameters | [TOOL](/AgentSite/tool/index.md) | Runtime source of truth |

## Depth Limit

- Preferred depth starts at two hops from home:
  home -> layer index -> target leaf page
- Expand beyond two hops when workflow dependencies require additional pages
- Add new pages only when a contract becomes too large for one page
- Avoid creating new nested directories under existing layer folders

**Subdirectories** under this directory:
- [memory](/AgentSite/memory/index.md)
- [output](/AgentSite/output/index.md)
- [runtime](/AgentSite/runtime/index.md)
- [soul](/AgentSite/soul/index.md)
- [tool](/AgentSite/tool/index.md)

**Pages** in this directory:
